title: Archify Community Package
description: Registry metadata for a standalone community package that builds on Archify. One file per package under community/packages/. The package content lives in the author's own repository; this file only indexes it.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier, unique across the registry. Also the file name: community/packages/<name>.json.

type.description: skill: agent skill pack; recipe: scenario/recipe library; brand-marks: brand-mark catalog or preset; locale: meta.translations catalog; wrapper: standalone tool that emits Archify JSON IR and calls the CLI.

repository.description: Public URL of the package source (git repository, npm page, or directory inside one).

archify.description: Compatible Archify version range, e.g. ^3.0.1 or >=3.0.0 <4.0.0.

schemaVersions.description: Archify JSON IR schema_version values the package can author.

evidence.description: Links to verification evidence: validation receipts, screenshots, rendered example artifacts. Evidence is authored by the submitter; Archify never executes third-party package code.
